rows.question: How strong was ABN AMRO's core capital position (CET1) at year-end 2025?
rows.gold: CET1 ratio of 15.4% at year-end 2025 (Basel IV)
rows.answer: ABN AMRO's CET1 ratio was 15.4% at 31 December 2025, up from 14.5% at 31 December 2024. The ratio is well above the maximum distributable amount (MDA) trigger level of 11.2%, above the 2026 target of 13.5% and above the new target of more than 13.75%.
